translations.web: The fish that are in the river will die and the river will become foul. The Egyptians will loathe to drink water from the river.” ’ ”
translations.bsb: The fish in the Nile will die, the river will stink, and the Egyptians will be unable to drink its water.’”
translations.kjv: And the fish that is in the river shall die, and the river shall stink; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river.
translations.asv: And the fish that are in the river shall die, and the river shall become foul; and the Egyptians shall loathe to drink water from the river.
